title: Charred Algerian Cabbage Tagine
description: A hearty North African-inspired stew featuring charred cabbage and a blend of aromatic spices. Perfect for a cozy dinner.

ingredients.name: algerian
ingredients.notes: use a North African spice blend or a mix of cumin, coriander, and paprika

ingredients.name: kissed
ingredients.notes: use a smoky paprika for a kissed flavor

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the cabbage and cook for 5 minutes until slightly charred.
Stir in the Algerian spice blend, kissed paprika, and lemon juice.
Pour in the water and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15-20 minutes until the cabbage is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
